## Privacy & Safety Checklist

- [ ] Adheres strictly to the Hunch Privacy Contract (no telemetry, no raw text/URL/keystroke collection).
- [ ] If schemas or `PrivacyGate` were modified, contract suites and drift tests pass.
- [ ] No personal identifiers, real notification data, or local machine paths are committed.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO).
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass on targeted platforms.
